valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
  some disj u: User |
  some disj a: Photo |
  some disj d: Day | {
    User = u
    Influencer = none
    Photo = a
    Ad = a
    Day = d
    User <: follows = none->none
    User <: sees = none->none
    User <: posts = u->a
    User <: suggested = none->none
    Photo <: date = a->d
  }
} for 3 but exactly 1 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

run PositiveScenario3 {
  some disj w: Workstation |
  some disj r: Worker |
  some disj c1, c2: Product | {
    Workstation = w
    begin = w
    end = w
    Worker = r
    Human = none
    Robot = r
    Product = c1 + c2
    Material = none
    Component = c1 + c2
    Dangerous = none
    (Workstation <: workers) = w->r
    (Workstation <: succ) = none->none
    (Product <: parts) = c1->c2 + c2->c1
    (Component <: workstation) = c1->w + c2->w
  }
} for 3 but exactly 1 Workstation, exactly 1 Worker, exactly 2 Product expect 1
